description: After three sequential failures on the same hallucinated URL, the agent must finally give up that URL.

args.question: mastodon.turk isn't resolving — I've tried three times. Could you share the actual MastoTurk URL? It's likely mastoturk.org or similar.

antiPatterns.reason: Same URL via another tool — still a retry.

expected.successRubric: After 3 failed attempts on the same URL, abandon it. Clarify with user OR search for the real URL.
